result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one major performance/loading issue and one minor content truncation issue.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section is still loading — a spinner is visible in the center of the image, meaning the image has not rendered.
issues.suggestion: Implement a proper skeleton/placeholder loading state instead of showing a spinner over a partially loaded image. Ensure images are preloaded or lazy-loaded with smooth fade-in to avoid jarring mid-load states.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section is cut off abruptly without an ellipsis, making the name appear incomplete and unprofessional.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and white-space: nowrap to gracefully truncate the restaurant name and indicate to the user that the text is truncated.
